question: Who among the following devised the Ryotwari system during the British rule in India?
solution:
The correct answer is** ​**__**Capt. Alexander Read**__.

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The arrangement was formulated by** Capt. Alexander Read and Thomas Munro **at the end of the **18th century** and launched by the latter when he was **governor (1820–27) of Madras. **
 
• The principle was the **direct collection of the land revenue** from every individual cultivator by government representatives.
 
• They had a permit to** sell**, **mortgage, or gift **the land.
 
• The taxes were** directly acquired** by the government from** the farmers**. 
 
• The taxes were **50% in dry areas** and **60% in wet areas.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Lord Minto** was the** 17th Viceroy** of India.**​ **
 
• **Lord Dalhousie** was responsible for introducing a variety of modern reforms like the **railways, telegraph and postal networks, and public works in India. **
 
• **Warren Hastings** was the **first governor-general of Bengal.**
